title: CUSTOMER SERVICE ADVISOR
company: Talent Sure Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Customer Service Advisor

Location: Bournemouth, Dorset

Salary: £25,000 per annum (increasing after probation)

Hours: Monday-Friday 8:30am 5:00pm (+ Occasional Saturday mornings)

Contract: Temporary to Permanent

About the Opportunity:

Are you looking to establish a rewarding career in a professional office environment? A fantastic opportunity has arisen for an enthusiastic and motivated Customer Service Advisor to join a highly successful, growing business based in central Bournemouth.

This role is perfect for an individual who is eager to gain valuable office experience within a supportive team. The company is renowned for its vibrant, inclusive, and positive workplace culture, offering excellent training and genuine opportunities for long-term professional development.

Key Responsibilities:

As a Customer Service Advisor, you will report directly to the Customer Service Manager and act as the first point of contact for clients and suppliers. Your day-to-day duties will include:
- Handling incoming telephone enquiries, addressing customer queries efficiently, or directing calls to the correct department.
- Listening to client requirements, providing clear support and advice, and ensuring an exceptional customer experience.
- Managing the customer service inbox, responding to emails promptly, or allocating complex queries to relevant internal teams.
- Liaising with suppliers on behalf of clients to resolve queries and ensure smooth communication.
- Updating and maintaining accurate client records, including company names and location changes.
- Monitoring and checking client deliveries, updating purchase orders accordingly.
- Sourcing emergency suppliers when required and verifying their documentation against regulatory standards.
- Escalating complex issues to the Customer Service Manager to ensure swift resolution.
- Assisting the management team with ad-hoc projects and administrative tasks.

What We Are Looking For:

While previous office experience is a bonus, it is not essential. We are looking for individuals who possess:
- Strong verbal and written communication skills with a professional telephone manner.
- Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage tasks in a fast-paced environment.
- A positive, proactive attitude and a willingness to learn.
- The ability to work effectively as part of a close-knit team.

Benefits & Culture:

This business prides itself on creating an outstanding work environment where employees feel valued. Alongside a structured training programme, you will benefit from:
- Starting Salary: £25,000, rising after probation.
- Annual Leave: 23 days holiday, increasing by 1 day for each consecutive year of service (capped at an additional 5 days).
- Bank Holidays: No bank holiday working required.
- Healthcare: Private healthcare plan option available post-probation.
- Wellbeing: On-site gym access and complimentary chiropractor sessions upon passing probation.
- Office Environment: Modern, central office space featuring dedicated breakout areas.
- Perks: Monthly team incentives and complimentary healthy beverages and breakfast options.

If you are ready to take the next step in your career with a supportive company that offers fantastic perks and a brilliant culture, please submit your CV for consideration.

- Free on-site parking.
- Supportive team and opportunities to develop your skills.

If you're looking for a varied customer support role with long-term potential, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Workflow Administrator
description: Shore Medical is seeking a Workflow Administrator to join our supportive team at Poole Road Medical Centre, working across the Shore Medical group. The role involves processing clinical correspondence, accurately updating patient records, identifying required actions and ensuring information is appropriately coded. You will work closely with GPs and the wider clinical team to support efficient workflows, maintain accurate patient records and reduce the administrative burden on clinicians. Job Type: Permanent, Part-time Hours: Wednesday 8.00 - 14.00, Thursday and Friday 8.00 - 18.00 Process incoming clinical correspondence across all Shore Medical practices. Accurately code diagnoses, procedures and investigations and update patient records. Identify any required follow-up actions and ensure these are directed to the appropriate team. Liaise with GPs, clinical staff and the Pharmacy team regarding clinical correspondence and medication reconciliation. Identify complex or high-risk correspondence requiring clinical input and escalate appropriately. Respond to queries relating to processed correspondence and investigate any identified incidents. Support the development of efficient workflows and improvements to administrative processes. Ensure patient records are accurate, up to date and consistently maintained. Process correspondence (paper, electronic, email) that is received across all practices within Shore Medical. Accurately code diagnoses, procedures and investigations, following the Shore Medical Workflow protocols. Liaise with the Pharmacy team to facilitate timely and accurate medications reconciliation, following agreed protocols. Identify and record key clinical data such as new diagnoses, BP recordings, smoking status, and other items as detailed in the Workflow guide. Identify any actions, such as blood tests to be arranged, and task the relevant group. Identify the complex or high-risk areas that require input or knowledge from the clinical team, including safeguarding issues, working to the agreed protocols. Liaise with clinical staff for complex correspondence. Responding promptly to any queries about letters processed by Workflow. Investigate incidents promptly and identify where changes need to be made to ensure prevention of future incidents. Help develop new ways of processing incoming paperwork and correspondence, including coding. Undertake additional tasks as required by the line manager or GP Partners.

title: Administrator
company: Dorset HealthCare University NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Dorset HealthCare University NHS Foundation Trust
description: The Dorset All Age Eating Disorders Service are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Team Secretary who preferably has a comprehensive knowledge of NHS secretarial and administrative procedures. This is a busy position and requires the post holder to be highly organised in co-ordinating their workload to efficiently meet the needs of the service. In this role you will receive peer support and supervision sessions. You will be joining a friendly, dynamic, professional multi-disciplinary team in a high paced environment where a flexible and adaptable approach with excellent multi-tasking abilities as well as a good understanding of Microsoft Office and a minimum of RSA/OCR II Typing / word processing qualification or equivalent is required. A working knowledge of RiO would be preferable. The role will be based at Kings Park Hospital in Bournemouth. If you have any queries about any aspect of the role or need additional information please contact Karen Bareham, Lead Administrator on 0300 019 1771. Employment in this post requires an Enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check, which the Trust will cover the cost of. You will support all Eating Disorder clinical staff by undertaking administrative and clerical duties including registering referrals, scheduling of appointments, typing all therapists' letters, team meeting minutes, professionals meeting minutes, as well as reception duties and answering and appropriately directing all calls into the service. You will provide information to patients, staff, carers, relatives, GPs, Community Health Teams, relating to appointments, patient care, service pathways and meetings, verballyby telephone, face to face or written in a tactful and courteous manner often requiringnon-clinical advice involving careful analysis of delicate situations regarding patientcare, requiring knowledge of patient confidentiality. You will organise and prioritise own routine and non-routine daily workload. To have input into developing, organising and implementing new office procedures and systems e.g.developing/updating databases, procedures for processing referrals and general day-to-day business. Please note visa sponsorship for this role is unfortunately not available. Please ensure you hold valid right to work in the UK and will not require sponsorship if successful. For the main duties and responsibilities for this role please read the attached job description and person specification. When completing your application please ensure your supporting statement reflects the criteria set out in these documents by showing how your experience and skills apply to this post. We understand that using AI can be a useful and supportive tool when completing your application. However, we have also seen an increase in the over-reliance of AI tools which is negatively impacting applications as they remove candidates individuality, and it becomes much harder to get a sense of who you are and your authentic experience. If you do use AI, it should be used to enhance your application and not to create your supporting statement in its entirety. If we suspect you have used AI to create your supporting statement and this does not match your experience, we may withdraw your application. As part of our vision to have a skilled, diverse and caring workforce, Dorset HealthCare offers support for people getting into work. We offer an employability service to support individuals with application writing, interview skills and other employment support. If you would like or know of anyone who would value this support, please do contact dhc.wideningparticipation@nhs.net This is a fixed term role and for those with current NHS service, the role will be offered on a secondment basis only. Please obtain permission to be released on a secondment before submitting an application.
